verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance publishes a public OpenAPI v3 spec for an OAuth client-credentials API built for server-to-server use, with rate-limit headers and idempotency keys that suit agent polling. Separately, the product monitors entity statuses and shows annual-report due dates and filing status. However, the only API endpoints the evidence confirms are registered-agent deliveries, so it is unproven that standing or deadlines can be read programmatically. Reminders are described only as user-customizable notifications, not machine-consumable events. Missing for 10: explicit API endpoints exposing entity standing and filing due dates, registrable outbound webhooks for status changes or approaching deadlines, and independent or hands-on confirmation of an agent-driven deadline-watch workflow.
